 Justice G. Satapathy
 Order

This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual/Physical Mode).
2.

This is the 2nd successive application U/S.483 of the BNSS by the petitioner for grant of bail in connection with Belpahar P.S. Case No.110 of 2024 corresponding to C.T. (Special) Case No. 29 of 2024 pending in the Court of learned ADJ-cum-P.O. (Special Court) POCSO, Jharsuguda, for commission of offence punishable U/Ss.376(AB)/506 of the IPC r/w. Sec.6 of the POCSO Act and Sec.3(1)(r)(s)/ 3(2)(v)(va) of the SC & ST (PoA) Act, on the main allegation of committing rape and aggravated penetrative sexual assault upon the victim aged about 13 years by taking advantage of her caste to be a member of SC community.

3. Heard, Mr. Julu Khansama, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. P. Satpathy, learned Additional Public Prosecutor in the matter and perused the record including the copy of deposition of the victim.
None appears for the victim/informant despite being duly informed as apprised by the learned State counsel.

4. After having considered the rival submissions and taking into consideration the nature and gravity of the offences as alleged against the petitioner vis--vis the accusations sought to be brought against him and regard being had to the materials collected in support of the allegation against the petitioner keeping in view the evidence of the victim and taking into account the other circumstances on record in entirety including the presumption as available U/S.29 of the POCSO Act, this Court is not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner.

Hence, the bail application of the petitioner stands rejected.

In view of the alternative oral prayer as advanced for the petitioner, the learned trial Court is requested to proceed with the case as expeditiously as possible, if there is no other legal impediment.
6. Accordingly, the bail application stands disposed of.
A copy of this order be immediately transmitted to the concerned Court for compliance.
